claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.Vertex
claims.statement: Finite vertex tags.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.RelationKind
claims.statement: Finite relation tags.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.EvidenceKind
claims.statement: Receipt and unverified evidence tags.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.Edge
claims.statement: Edge has source, target, relation, evidence.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.PathRecord
claims.statement: Path record retains start, finish, ordered edges.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.follow
claims.statement: Follow ordered composable receipt edges or return none.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.pathValid
claims.statement: Path is valid when follow reaches declared finish.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.checkedAppend
assumptions: Valid prefix, endpoint, and receipt checks
claims.statement: Append only after the existing path is valid and the edge is endpoint-matching with a receipt tag.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.deleteLastEdges
claims.statement: Delete the final edge from a record's edge history.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.coOccur
claims.statement: Two vertices occur in a roster.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.noEdgeBetween
claims.statement: No listed directed edge has selected endpoints.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.follow_append_edge
assumptions: Valid prefix, matching source, receipt evidence
claims.statement: Following a valid prefix plus a checked edge reaches its target.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.checkedAppend_valid
claims.statement: Successful checked append derives path validity from its validated prefix and checked edge.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.delete_appended_edge_recovers_predecessor
claims.statement: Deleting a just-appended edge recovers the predecessor list.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.ab
claims.statement: Receipt edge a to b.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.bc
claims.statement: Receipt edge b to c.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.wrongEndpoint
claims.statement: Receipt edge with wrong source for pathAB.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.wrongEvidence
claims.statement: Endpoint-matching unverified edge.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.emptyAtA
claims.statement: Empty path identity at a.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.pathAB
claims.statement: One-edge path a to b.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.malformedAtB
claims.statement: Malformed empty-edge record whose declared finish disagrees with its start.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.cooccurringRoster
claims.statement: Roster containing a and b.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.noEdges
claims.statement: Empty edge list.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.empty_path_valid
claims.statement: Empty fixture is valid.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.append_ab_creates_valid_path
claims.statement: Appending ab to emptyAtA yields valid pathAB.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.append_bc_preserves_ordered_history
claims.statement: Appending bc retains ordered history [ab,bc].

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.mismatched_endpoint_rejected
claims.statement: Wrong endpoint append returns none.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.unverified_evidence_rejected
claims.statement: Unverified evidence append returns none.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.malformed_prefix_rejected
claims.statement: An endpoint-matching receipt edge is rejected when the existing path record is malformed.
claims.residual: The receipt tag is not authenticated evidence.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24TypedPaths.cooccurrence_without_edge_countermodel
claims.statement: a and b co-occur while no edge a to b exists.

manual_dispositions.detail: No source authentication, relation/evidence registry, provenance semantics, self-edge policy, fixed-roster coverage, or flat cycle validator is formalized.
